The Chinese characters for Diane

As a transliteration, Diane is usually written 黛安 (Dài ān). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

黛
Dài
dark blue (eyebrow pigment)
安
ān
peace, safe

Origin and meaning

Diane comes from Latin and means “divine (form of Diana)”.

About the name Diane

A French form of Diana, the Roman goddess of the hunt.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Diane carries the meaning “divine (form of Diana)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
